integrity: The 34 blocks and finite verifier are embedded as standalone files. The verifier checks all five-block subfamilies exactly. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Establishes only beta(4,16) >= 34 and the general upper bound beta(4,16) <= 37; exact value and isomorphism classification remain unresolved. The finite checker proves the property of the displayed family only.
title: A 34-triple packing on 16 points with no five disjoint blocks
